# ResumeRadar

> ResumeRadar is a free, private ATS resume checker that runs entirely in the browser. Paste a resume and a job description to get a 0–100 match score, missing keywords, parser warnings, and prioritized fixes. Pro is a one-time $9 unlock.

## Product

- [Free ATS resume checker](https://automatethebs.github.io/resume-radar/free-ats-resume-checker.html): score a resume against any job post. No signup, no upload.
- [ResumeRadar vs Jobscan](https://automatethebs.github.io/resume-radar/jobscan-alternative.html): an honest comparison of the private, $9 one-time checker and Jobscan's account-based platform.
- [What is a good ATS score?](https://automatethebs.github.io/resume-radar/what-is-a-good-ats-score.html): score bands, the four weighted checks, and why 100 is not the goal.
- [Sample ATS report](https://automatethebs.github.io/resume-radar/sample-report.html): see a complete example report with score, keyword gaps, and fixes.
- [Pricing](https://automatethebs.github.io/resume-radar/pricing.html): free scan; Pro is $9 once, no subscription.
- [How it works](https://automatethebs.github.io/resume-radar/how-it-works.html): scoring methodology, ATS explanation, and limitations.
- [Role guides](https://automatethebs.github.io/resume-radar/roles.html): 39 role-specific keyword lists with copyable terms.
- [Job description keyword extractor](https://automatethebs.github.io/resume-radar/keyword-extractor.html): paste a posting to get a ranked, copyable keyword list. Free and local.
- [All resume guides](https://automatethebs.github.io/resume-radar/guides.html): free format, template, verb, and summary guides in one place.
- [ATS resume format](https://automatethebs.github.io/resume-radar/ats-resume-format.html): the nine formatting rules that decide whether a parser can read a resume.
- [Free ATS resume template](https://automatethebs.github.io/resume-radar/free-ats-resume-template.html): a single-column skeleton to copy, download, or print. No email gate.
- [Resume action verbs](https://automatethebs.github.io/resume-radar/resume-action-verbs.html): 200+ strong verbs by function, with weak phrases to replace and before/after examples.
- [Resume summary examples](https://automatethebs.github.io/resume-radar/resume-summary-examples.html): 39 role-specific summaries built on a three-sentence formula.
- [Resume summary generator](https://automatethebs.github.io/resume-radar/resume-summary-generator.html): generate three editable summary variants from a role, skills, and one measurable result.
- [Crypto & Web3 resume checker](https://automatethebs.github.io/resume-radar/web3.html): Web3 role checklists and accountless USDC Pro checkout.
- [How to pay with USDC](https://automatethebs.github.io/resume-radar/pay-with-usdc.html): step-by-step Base payment guide, network details, and troubleshooting.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Resume text is processed locally and never sent to a server.
- The score measures keyword match, parser-safe structure, measurable impact, and readability. It cannot predict interviews or hiring outcomes.
- Pro unlocks every missing keyword, the full role checklist, all fixes, and a text export.
- Payment is a one-time $9 purchase. Card checkout (Stripe) can be enabled by the operator; the default rail is USDC on Base, verified in the buyer's browser.
- Support is handled through the public issue tracker: https://github.com/automatethebs/resume-radar/issues
